lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Spatial arrangement of circular high-luminance pixel clusters forming roughly horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region; density decreases and mean blob diameter increases toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with the primary horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like topology.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features on the dorsal-lateral flank displaying sharp vertical intensity gradients (high luminance superiorly, low luminance inferiorly).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-intensity pixel clusters within the dorsal fin mask, localized primarily toward the leading edge.
